overview.description: The Baillie Gifford U.S. Equity Growth ETF (BGUS) is an exchange-traded fund that mostly invests in total market equity. The fund is an actively managed ETF focused on identifying and owning exceptional US growth companies through patient, bottom-up research. The ETF constructs a concentrated portfolio of 3050 high-conviction holdings, with a long-term investment horizon typically spanning at least five years. BGUS was launched on Jul 27, 2026 and is issued by Baillie Gifford Funds.

holdings.infoBox: BGUS is an equity ETF with a total of 49 individual holdings. The top holdings are NVIDIA stock at 15.17%, Alphabet at 6.57%, Amazon.com at 4.16%, Meta Platforms at 3.89%, and Shopify at 3.84%.
